metadata.name: sunhoard
metadata.description: Sunhoard program. Rules live in logic/; instructions call them.

instructions.name: arena_input
docs: Stores the move the next tick will use.

instructions.name: bell_cb
docs: The wanderer roll.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: buy
docs: Buys a listing: both purses, the item and the Hearth Penny split move
atomically.

instructions.name: cancel
docs: Takes an unsold listing back. The deposit stays burned.

instructions.name: catch_spark
docs: Scoops a nearby spark into the purse.

instructions.name: chest_cb
docs: Pays the boss chest once the glow roll lands.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: claim
docs: Pays one unclaimed share from the Vault.

instructions.name: collect
docs: Settles villager output into the pack.

instructions.name: crack
docs: Charges the thaw fee and marks the shell. The contents stay hidden.

instructions.name: crack_reveal
docs: Opens a shell that was cracked in an earlier slot. The salt is not logged.

instructions.name: craft
docs: The workbench: materials pay out now, gear waits for one rarity roll.

instructions.name: craft_cb
docs: Writes the crafted gear's rarity and traits. The roll is not logged.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: delegate_home
docs: Delegates Village, Arena and View.

instructions.name: delegate_player
docs: Delegates Player, Purse and Inventory. Village, Arena and View are the next transaction.

instructions.name: delegate_shared
docs: Delegates Season, World, Market, PriceBoard and Presence to the given validator.

instructions.name: demo_grant
docs: Demo grants, tagged DEMO. Works only in demo mode.

instructions.name: dungeon_cb
docs: Writes the room seed. The bytes are not logged.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: eat
docs: Eats one meal from the pack. At most four a day.

instructions.name: enter_dungeon
docs: Opens a room, asks the VRF for its seed, and schedules the 100 ms crank.

instructions.name: enter_lair
docs: Steps into the Crater. The Glare runs here: a warm purse is marked.

instructions.name: equip
docs: Equips the gear in one pack slot. The dungeon reads it on entry.

instructions.name: exit_dungeon
docs: Stops the crank. A cleared sixth room banks the run and rolls the chest.

instructions.name: exit_lair
docs: Leaves the Crater early. The flushed damage still counts.

instructions.name: feed
docs: Feeds the village stockpile from the pack.

instructions.name: gather
docs: Pays the base yield and asks the VRF for the aberration roll.

instructions.name: gather_cb
docs: Adds the aberration, or nothing. The roll is not logged.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: init_game
docs: Creates Season, World, Market, PriceBoard, Presence and the Vault.
Seeds the Vault, tops up the Magic Action escrow, and prefunds permission rent.

instructions.name: init_payout
docs: Creates the season-1 payout record on Solana. It is never delegated.

instructions.name: join
docs: Assigns a player number, gives Nell's bound block, and locks Purse and View.

instructions.name: lair_cb
docs: Writes the visit seed. The bytes are not logged.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: lair_input
docs: Stores the move the next lair tick will use.

instructions.name: list
docs: Lists one pack slot on the Coldfair at a fixed price. 1 Glint deposit.

instructions.name: merchant_buy
docs: Buys one good from Auntie Pell's shop.

instructions.name: merchant_sell
docs: Sells one slot to Auntie Pell at the Charter price.

instructions.name: name_wyrm
docs: The Ember Egg holder names the next wyrm (A–Z and spaces, up to 16 chars).

instructions.name: next_room
docs: Advances to the next room after a clear. Session-signed; the seed is VRF.

instructions.name: place_gem
docs: Sets a block into a built lantern post.

instructions.name: post_position
docs: Writes Player and Presence when the move fits the combat speed.

instructions.name: record_payout
docs: Writes the SOL split from the committed damage table.

instructions.name: recruit
docs: Recruits the waiting wanderer for a 15-Glint gift.

instructions.name: ring_bell
docs: Rings the Hearth Bell. One VRF roll decides whether a wanderer comes.

instructions.name: salt_cb
docs: Writes the salt into World. The bytes are not logged.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: schedule_world
docs: The admin schedules the season-clock crank once per season.

instructions.name: set_demo_mode
docs: The admin flips demo mode, which the season clock and chest odds read.

instructions.name: set_permissions_shared
docs: World becomes private with no members. The other shared accounts stay public.

instructions.name: settle_season
docs: Commits Season and schedules the payout record. Old Gloam's HP must be 0.

instructions.name: sign_up
docs: Creates the six player accounts and prefunds Purse and View permission rent.

instructions.name: start_season
docs: Asks the VRF for the season salt. The callback opens season 1.

instructions.name: strike
docs: Strikes the anvil: the item, fodder and Glints go in, one VRF roll
decides whether it comes out a rarity higher.

instructions.name: strike_cb
docs: The strike roll: a win raises the rarity, a crack returns scrap.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: take_gem
docs: Takes a placed block back into the pack.

instructions.name: tick_arena
docs: Advances one fixed step when at least 8 slots have passed.

instructions.name: tick_lair
docs: Advances one fixed 100 ms step of the visit. Anyone may call it.

instructions.name: tick_world
docs: One season-clock tick: phases, Pell's Wants, bounties. Anyone may call.

errors.name: NotReady
errors.msg: That action is not available yet.

errors.name: SunFree
errors.msg: Old Gloam has fallen. The sun is free.

fields.name: weapon_keen
docs: The weapon the run uses: material, rarity and the two combat traits.

fields.name: boss_attack
docs: The Snuffer's current attack pattern: 0 idle, 1 ember, 2 wick, 3 snuff.

fields.name: boss_telegraph
docs: Telegraph steps left before the attack lands.

fields.name: boss_cd
docs: Steps until the Snuffer picks its next attack.

fields.name: carry_hp
docs: HP carried between rooms; the lantern restores 30% of what is missing.

fields.name: cleared
docs: 1 when the current room is cleared and `next_room` may run.

fields.name: chest_pending
docs: 1 while a chest roll is still on its way.

fields.name: lair
docs: 1 when this arena is running a lair visit, not a dungeon.

fields.name: chest_nonce
docs: Nonce of the chest VRF request, so a stale callback cannot land twice.

fields.name: lair_hits
docs: Hits since the last spark in the Gloaming.

fields.name: spark_value
docs: The spark's Sunhoard share, and the heal if it drifts back.

fields.name: slow
docs: Steps of Snuff frost left: −40% speed.

fields.name: meals
docs: Meals eaten today, capped at `MEALS_PER_DAY`.

fields.name: equipped_slot
docs: Inventory slot of the equipped gear, or 255 for none.

fields.name: meals_day
docs: The unix day the meal counter belongs to.

fields.name: chests_day
docs: The unix day the chest counters belong to.

fields.name: craft_at
docs: When the pending craft started; a stale request may be replaced.

fields.name: heat_at
docs: When the anvil last changed heat; 30 idle minutes cool it.

fields.name: strike_at
docs: The pending strike: the slot it is forging, when it started.

fields.name: strike_inputs
docs: The value of the fodder and Glints already consumed.

fields.name: strike_glints
docs: The Glints the player fed the strike, kept for the win/lose split.

fields.name: born_at
docs: When the wallet signed up. The payout's equal share checks its age.

fields.name: last_collect
docs: When villager output was last settled into the stockpile.
